nodes.title: MCP spec revision 2026-07-28 (true latest stable)
nodes.summary: Stable release 2026-07-28T16:47Z (RC 2026-05-29). Prior: 2024-11-05, 2025-03-26, 2025-06-18, 2025-11-25 (RC 2025-11-15). Repo draft/ dir has empty changelog; commits through 2026-10-23.
nodes.overclaim_risk: Next revision may land soon (WGs active); pinning to 2026-07-28 may need re-eval
nodes.underclaim_risk: Treating 2025-11-25 as latest (most training data/blogs) is wrong; SDKs already implement 2026-07-28

nodes.title: MCP 2026-07-28 removes sessions and initialize handshake
nodes.summary: No Mcp-Session-Id (SEP-2567); no initialize; each request carries protocolVersion/clientCapabilities in _meta; server/discover MUST; subscriptions/listen replaces GET stream; SSE resumability (Last-Event-ID) removed; MRTR (InputRequiredResult) replaces server-initiated sampling/elicitation/roots requests; Mcp-Method/Mcp-Name headers required; ttlMs/cacheScope on list results; tasks moved to extension io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks; error codes -32020..-32099 reserved.
nodes.overclaim_risk: Clients/servers in the wild still speak 2025-11-25 with sessions; dual-stack required
nodes.underclaim_risk: Statelessness removes whole session-table CVE class and simplifies crash isolation/horizontal scale

nodes.title: MCP authorization (2026-07-28): OAuth 2.1 + PRM + CIMD
nodes.summary: Auth OPTIONAL; HTTP only; stdio SHOULD NOT. MCP server MUST implement RFC 9728 PRM; AS needs RFC 8414 or OIDC discovery; RFC 8707 resource indicators; RFC 9207 iss validation (client MUST validate if present); Client ID Metadata Documents SHOULD (draft-ietf-oauth-client-id-metadata-document-00 cited; datatracker now rev 02, 2026-07-06); RFC 7591 DCR DEPRECATED (MAY); credentials keyed by issuer; cites draft-ietf-oauth-v2-1-13 (datatracker now rev 16, 2026-09-03). Token passthrough forbidden.
nodes.overclaim_risk: Depends on non-RFC drafts (OAuth 2.1 and CIMD still I-Ds); spec cites older revisions
nodes.underclaim_risk: RFC 9728/9207/8707/8414 are real RFCs; the RFC-based core is stable

nodes.title: MCP security best practices page (2026-07-28)
nodes.summary: Sections: confused deputy (proxy consent, state, cookies), token passthrough (MUST NOT accept tokens not issued for the server), SSRF, state-handle hijacking, local server compromise, auth URL validation, stdio in proxy scenarios, mix-up attacks, localhost redirect impersonation, CIMD trust policies, scope minimization. Streamable HTTP spec: MUST validate Origin; SHOULD bind 127.0.0.1.
nodes.overclaim_risk: Page is informative guidance in docs/ not the normative spec tree
nodes.underclaim_risk: Maps one-to-one to invariants and the SDK advisories below

nodes.title: MCP transports: stdio and Streamable HTTP only
nodes.summary: 2026-07-28 basic/transports has only stdio.mdx and streamable-http.mdx. HTTP+SSE (2024-11-05) reclassified Deprecated (SEP-2596; min 12-month deprecation policy). IETF individual drafts for MCP over MoQ (draft-jennings-mcp-over-moqt-00, 2026-04-23) are not adopted. Python SDK shipped a WebSocket transport (advisory CVE-2026-59950) not in spec.
nodes.overclaim_risk: Custom transports allowed by spec ('alternative transports') so more may exist in practice
nodes.underclaim_risk: None found of newer official transports

nodes.title: Official MCP SDK transport/auth CVE cluster (Apr-Oct 2026)
nodes.summary: rmcp 7 GHSAs (DNS rebinding CVE-2026-42559; session leak DoS CVE-2026-63128; PRM validation CVE-2026-63127; header leak CVE-2026-64684; tool_schemas cache DoS GHSA-4432-vg92-fqh6 2026-10-20; incomplete SSRF fix GHSA-5p52-q7pq-9fq2 2026-10-22). TS SDK ~10 incl. token passthrough CVE-2026-111771, cross-client leakage CVE-2026-111770, memory exhaustion CVE-2026-111768, no body limits. Python SDK ~12 incl. sessions without principal check CVE-2026-52869, OAuth creds to attacker AS CVE-2026-115563, $ref SSRF. Classes: DNS rebinding, metadata-discovery SSRF, audience confusion, unbounded input/state, cross-client leak, redirect header leak.
nodes.overclaim_risk: Advisory counts partially reflect heightened auditing/AI-found bugs, not only baseline quality; CVE numbers of form CVE-2026-1xxxxx are as returned by GitHub API
nodes.underclaim_risk: Same bug classes will exist in any hand-rolled MCP gateway; they are a free test-oracle corpus

nodes.summary: WG chartered ~2025-10-23. Adopted draft: HTTP Message Signatures for automated traffic (Meunier/Cloudflare, Major/Google), Std Track, expires 2027-03-05: Signature-Agent header, JWKS directory at /.well-known/http-message-signatures-directory, media type application/http-message-signatures-directory+json, tag="web-bot-auth", ed25519/RSA-PSS vectors; rev 02 pre-adoption changelog: Signature-Agent required on every signed request. Related individual: architecture-05 (2026-03-02), directory-05, registry-03, use-cases-02 (Nottingham 2026-10-03), cbcp-01 / jafar-01 (Illyes/Google 2026-10-22), sail-00, rescorla-anonymous-01, hardt-httpbis-signature-key-09 (2026-09-13). nodes.title: Single handler definition -> JSON Schema 2020-12 -> OpenAPI 3.2 + MCP tool schema + WebMCP + Server Card
nodes.summary: Evidence: MCP 2026-07-28 inputSchema/outputSchema = JSON Schema 2020-12 (SEP-2106) with $ref resolution and composition-bounds requirements; OAS 3.1/3.2 same dialect; WebMCP tools use JSON-schema parameters; MCP x-mcp-header lets tool params surface as HTTP headers (SEP-2243) so the gateway can authorize without parsing bodies; ttlMs/cacheScope give cacheable list results. Proposed artifact: handler IR emits 4 projections; CI gate = round-trip schema equality + deny $ref to external URLs (matches python-sdk $ref SSRF advisory).
nodes.overclaim_risk: Inference from specs, not an existence proof of a safe projector
nodes.underclaim_risk: Standards converge enough that a single IR is feasible

protocol_implications: MCP pin: target 2026-07-28 as primary with 2025-11-25 compatibility shim; the revision is stateless (no Mcp-Session-Id, no initialize) so the MCP layer can be a pure per-request function - favors crash isolation and horizontal scale.
Auth: implement RFC 9728 PRM + RFC 8707 audience binding + RFC 9207 iss check + CIMD; DCR only as legacy; reject token passthrough by construction (audience-typed tokens).
Treat official-SDK advisory classes (DNS rebinding/Origin check, metadata SSRF, unbounded bodies/schema caches, cross-client leakage, redirect header leakage) as mandatory test oracles.

Agent identity: Web Bot Auth (draft-ietf-webbotauth-httpsig-protocol-00 on RFC 9421) is the only agent-identity track with WG adoption plus CDN deployment; expect pre-verified signals from Cloudflare/Akamai; still build a bounded-fetch verifier.

Payments: x402 v2 and MPP both ride HTTP 402; real volume evidence is thin and unreconciled (agentic share <8%); make payment gating an optional module behind a generic 402 interface, not a core dependency.
Preferences: emit both IETF Content-Usage and Cloudflare Content-Signal in robots.txt; llms.txt is cheap but little consumed.
Projection: JSON Schema 2020-12 is the shared denominator across MCP 2026-07-28, OpenAPI 3.1/3.2 and WebMCP; one handler IR can emit all.
self_improvement: gh api + datatracker REST API (name__contains, group__acronym) gave fast ground truth; WebFetch summarizer answers can be incomplete and should be double-checked with curl for load-bearing facts.
Claude WebSearch results are secondary summaries; require primary-URL fetch before grading above C.

Add a standard 'fetch advisories via gh api repos/*/security-advisories' step to every crate/SDK node.
